sys_atf_test.description: Validates SnackFlow Production Cost Calc (before/100) and the consumption/output refresh rules (after/200) on a purpose-created production order. Consumes 20 kg Flour at 45 and 5 L Oil at 140 for a material cost of 1600, plus 100 Printed Pouches whose unit_cost is blank so packaging contributes 0 and packaging_cost_complete stays false; with labour 300 and overhead 150 asserts total_cost 2050 over 95 good packets and cost per packet 2050/95. Also asserts the consumption rows posted nothing to the stock ledger.
sys_atf_test.name: SnackFlow: production cost, cost per packet and packaging completeness
